title: My Best Friend Just Texted Me 'Don't Open The Door'... While Sitting Next To Me

lines.text: Bob texted: Don't open the door... while sitting next to you.
For the last twenty minutes.
Then he sends a photo... of your living room.
In the photo, it isn't watching the TV.
It's staring at your throat.
Bob... did you just text me?
His lips don't move. His throat does.
Let me in, I'm freezing!
Then someone pounds on the front door.
The real Bob. He holds up his phone.
Hold your breath. It hunts by sound.
The TV switches to your security feed.
On screen, it climbs over the couch.
Then you see the corner: five-second delay.
It's already behind you.
You hold your breath.
So it calls your phone.
It rises behind you. Bob's face splits.
Straight down the middle.
He told you not to open the door... so now you're locked in here with me.
The real Bob just kicked the door open.
Smash, hide, or run? Comment now.
